title: The Reporter in the built chat: the report for a manager or the team, from the records, with the full report to download
request: Reporter: "write me the report for my manager", cited and from the records.
spec: dclab_rnd/studio/solution_report.py (17.7, every number traced to a record; the reporter role's cited prose, 18.7) and the built chat (draft/orchestrator.py).
plan: One build per set of records shared by the download route and the chat (solution_report.latest).
write_report (Reporter): the manager's four sections or the team's six, a few lines each, the person's decisions from memory, the cites, a download.
The card's download through DC.client.href (never a path string).
Routing; review; data limits on a regression project; agent-eval and harness-eval.

decisions.decision: The chat shows a short version and links the full report, rather than writing new prose.
decisions.why: The report's prose is written by code from the records (a model's summary kept only where cited.check passes); a second writer would need its own checks.

decisions.decision: The tool returns how many numbers were traced, not the numbers.
decisions.why: Their record keys can name a table's values (a segment's name), and the built chat's model may see none.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/orchestrator.py (Reporter, write_report, asks_for_report), studio/solution_report.py (latest), agentic/routers/projects.py (the route uses latest), web/src/views/home.html (download), tests

findings.defect: The tool's result sent table values to the built chat's model.
findings.scenario: A regression project: numbers keys held all 7 segment names and the outcome's training minimum.
findings.cause: report.numbers is keyed by record paths, which can include a segment's value; the cites too.
findings.fix: Return only the count; cites cut to their first three parts.

findings.defect: Summaries of one subject and notes went to the Reporter.
findings.scenario: "give me a summary of the data" -> write_report; "Remember that we need a monthly report for the board" lost the note.
findings.cause: "summary" after any verb matched; the report check ran before remember.
findings.fix: asks_for_report: no plot, cell, improvement or named subject unless for an audience; remember first.

findings.defect: A project made private still got the model's prose from the cache.
findings.scenario: Build the report, set settings.private, ask again.
findings.cause: The cache key covered the records only.
findings.fix: The key covers privacy and whether prose was possible.

findings.defect: A programme project got "final stage missing".
findings.scenario: A problem of several parts with a programme holdout.
findings.fix: A card with the programme's report to download.
findings.test: not tested (no programme fixture in the chat tests)

findings.defect: "Download the report" went to the improvement run's report.
findings.fix: Not counted as a named subject.

measurements.name: affected tests
measurements.result: home orchestrator 50, model data limits 36, report cache 2, roles layer 10
limits: no live model run of the Reporter yet

outcome: The Reporter answers report requests in the chat from the records, for a manager or the team, without a value reaching the model.
lessons: A tool's result goes to the model too: check what it returns, not only what its card shows.
Record paths are data: a key can carry a value of the table.
risks: The manager lines are the report's first lines per section, not a rewrite for that reader.
